description: The line chart titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset" presents a comparison of three metrics—precision, recall, and F1-score—across five different model variants of MS-FSLHate. The x-axis, labeled 'Model Variants', is categorical and includes the variants 'Full model (Ours)', 'w/o Prompt', 'w/o Augmentation', 'w/o Attention', and 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. The y-axis, labeled 'Metric (%)', is linear and ranges from 58 to 66, marked at intervals of 2%. The 'Precision' line is colored purple, marked with circles, and has a solid line style, starting at approximately 65.45% for the 'Full model (Ours)' and showing a consistent decline across the variants, reaching its lowest point at 57.74% for 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. The 'Recall' line is blue, also marked with circles and a solid line, beginning at 65.78% for 'Ours', dropping sharply to 59.64% with 'w/o Prompt', and continuing to decline steadily, reaching 56.82% at 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. The 'F1-score' line is brown, marked with circles and a solid line, starting at 65.16%, decreasing to 60.16% for 'w/o Prompt', and showing a slight increase at 'w/o Augmentation' before dropping again to 57.74% with 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. Each data point is annotated with its respective value, providing a clear and precise reference for the metrics at each model variant. The chart includes a legend in the bottom left corner, which allows for easy identification of each line by its corresponding label.
